description:
YACHASKA — Stories Beyond the Stars

Hi! I’m Jokabel, a software engineering technician studying data science. I’m building YACHASKA, a creative project blending science, storytelling, art, and interactive web development to bring forgotten NASA machines on the Moon and Mars back into the spotlight.

I welcome developers, writers, artists, designers, and space enthusiasts who want to create, learn, and explore together. No expertise required—just curiosity, commitment, and a passion for the idea. Join YACHASKA and help bring these stories to life!
